title: Simultaneous degreewise injective K-injective tower resolutions
statement: Let $C$ be a small site with topology $J$, with sheafification for abelian groups and its locally bijective characterization. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings and let $A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], in a universe containing the site and coefficients. Assume chosen derived categories of $A$ and $\operatorname{Tow}(A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}},A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the arithmetic restriction $r_e$, its induced complex and derived functors, the termwise limit $L$, limit restriction $\alpha_e$, the boundary $\delta$, selection $a_e$, block map $b_e$, and mapping cocone $M$ of [def-sp-strict-tower-arithmetic-restriction-data]. Let $F:D(\operatorname{Tow}(A))\to D(A)$ with $\eta:QL\to FQ$ be a total right derived inverse limit as in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], with $\eta_I$ invertible for K-injective $I$. For every $e\geq1$ and tower complex $X$, there is a quasi-isomorphism $j:X\to I$ such that $I$ is K-injective, each tower $I^i$ is injective, $r_e I$ is K-injective, and $r_e j$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Here injective has its extension-property meaning [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Moreover, for any abelian category $B$, the restriction $r_e$ sends every K-injective complex of towers in $B$ to a K-injective complex.

lean.statement:
theorem strictTowerArithmeticRestrictionResolution
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max uC vC r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max uC vC r}]
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{max uC vC r})
    (_hcomm : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (a b : R.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R)]
    (RF : DerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R) ⥤
      DerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R))
    (η : limitComplex (ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q.{w} ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.{w} ⋙ RF)
    (_hRF : RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor η
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R)
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (_hη : ∀ I, CochainComplex.IsKInjective I → IsIso (η.app I)) :
      (∀ (e : ℕ) (_he : 1 ≤ e) X,
        ∃ (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R) ℤ) (j : X ⟶ I),
          QuasiIso j ∧ I.IsKInjective ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Injective (I.X i)) ∧
            CochainComplex.IsKInjective ((complexRestriction _ e).obj I) ∧
            QuasiIso ((complexRestriction _ e).map j))
